chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man praying in one corner of the room while his wife or his daughter is praying beside him in the other corner. He said: That is not appropriate; but if there is a span between them, it suffices—that is, when the man is ahead of the woman by a span.

key_terms.شِبْرٌ: a handspan; a small measure of distance

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man and a woman praying side by side in the same room?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling of a man and a woman praying in close alignment within the same room. It indicates that praying directly side by side is not appropriate, and that a slight forward separation of the man by a handspan is sufficient.
